text:
Predicates:
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
Symptoms(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
FeelTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Glu(x) ::: x has glu.

Premises:
MonkeypoxVirus(x) ∧ Cause(x, monkeypox) ::: Monkeypox is caused by monkeypox virus.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, animals) ∨ OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, humans) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Mammal(human) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) → Animal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptoms(monkeypox) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
FeelTired(x) ← Glu(x) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.

Conclusion:
∃x Animal(x) ::: There is an animal.
